title: Correct CI evidence job scope and conclusion reporting
outOfScope: weakening required CI, SBOM, provenance, or release evidence validation

preReviewWarnings: Do not weaken required-job validation; the terminal aggregate must always declare and record template-smoke, installation-smoke, and release-evidence, including skipped results.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: The terminal ci-evidence Job runs after template-smoke, installation-smoke, and release-evidence with if: always(), declares all three as required, and records every needs result including skipped.
A2: Evidence records executed, skipped, and failed jobs with accurate conclusions and failure reasons; a successful template-smoke job is never emitted as template-smoke:success failure reason.
A3: Validator diagnostics distinguish missing required job evidence from head-SHA binding failure without weakening either gate.
A4: Regression coverage reproduces the PR #408/CI run 30266670055 structural failure and covers all-three success, upstream failure with dependent Jobs skipped, and an individual downstream failure.
A5: The plan records RFE-ISSUE-100 and the corrective dependency; WI-21 remains release-blocking until revalidation succeeds.
A6: All required AI/project checks pass and this Work Item completes PR, merge, archive, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and base synchronization without publishing a release.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed behavior for verified and published evidence.
Add regression coverage before changing the workflow evidence contract.
Do not change release identity or publish provider assets.

intent.problem: PR #408 run 30266670055 passed the expensive quality gates but failed in its always-run evidence step because the step emitted only template-smoke while declaring installation-smoke and release-evidence required. This repeated the class of process failure previously recorded as RFE-ISSUE-095.
constraints: Keep WI-21, WI-10, and release publication out of scope.
Make evidence scope explicit and machine-checkable.
intent.rationale: Correct the workflow/validator contract at its source before re-running or merging the blocked performance Work Item.

rawUserRequest: PR #408 run 30266670055 的 Head SHA 正确；真正根因是 requiredJobNames 声明三个 Job，但证据步骤位于 template-smoke 内，只能生成 template-smoke，随后下游 Job 因 needs 被 skipped，且校验器把缺失 Job 与 Head 错误合并。请建立末端 ci-evidence Job，needs 三个 Job、if: always()，记录全部真实状态，拆分诊断并增加完整回归测试；先完成该 corrective Work Item，再恢复 WI-21。
